meta.title: Use cases
meta.description: Open new accounts, grow your existing customers and prepare for your sales meetings faster.

hero.title: Built for IT services firms that want to open more accounts - and make better use of the ones they already have.
hero.subtitle: Concrete use cases for every key role in your organization.

items.title: Open a new account
items.frustration: You know a company's name but you don't know the right departments, the decision-makers or the projects underway.
items.solution: BellumAI brings together the potential, recent signals, relevant entities, sites, contacts, the org chart and the action plan.

items.title: Grow an existing account
items.frustration: Your IT services firm already works with one team but can't open up new departments.
items.solution: BellumAI highlights complementary entities, other sites, new decision-makers and multi-threading opportunities.

items.title: Prepare for a meeting
items.frustration: You piece together the account's history at the last minute before every meeting.
items.solution: BellumAI generates an executive summary, recent signals, key stakes, key contacts and a shareable battle card.

items.title: Place a consultant
items.frustration: You have an outstanding profile but you don't know which companies might need their skills.
items.solution: BellumAI spots job postings, the technologies in demand, the teams that are hiring, the right sites and the decision-makers to approach.

items.title: Manage the sales team
items.frustration: Every rep works with their own method and information isn't captured.
items.solution: BellumAI structures a shared portfolio, account files, histories, action plans and exports.
